name: What factors influence the cost of a custom patio, and how do you provide estimates?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of a custom patio, and how do you provide estimates?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom patio is influenced by several key factors, including the size and complexity of the design, the types of materials selected (e.g., natural stone versus stamped concrete), the inclusion of additional features like outdoor kitchens or fire pits, and any necessary site preparation or grading. AKN Design Group provides upfront estimates based on a comprehensive design consultation. We believe in transparency and value engineering, ensuring that our proposals reflect the customized solutions that enhance functionality, beauty, and long-term value for your high-end outdoor living space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include size, complexity, materials, and added features. We provide upfront estimates based on a comprehensive design consultation, focusing on transparency and value.
